verdict.rationale: CodeRabbit's FAQ states that it never uses customer code for model training. It also says that neither CodeRabbit nor its model providers (OpenAI, Anthropic) train on your code, so the protection applies by default with no opt-out needed. Further controls are documented: a data retention opt-out on self-hosted Enterprise, a separate model-output logging setting, and a fully self-hosted deployment option. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the no-training policy, in-depth policy or contractual documentation beyond FAQ statements, and explicit coverage of non-code data such as chat and learnings.
